muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /api/items/{id} marshalJSON(GetItem(ctx, id))" -}}{{- if .Err -}}bad-id{{- end -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Item struct {
	ID int `json:"id"`
}

type T struct{}

func (T) GetItem(_ context.Context, id int) (Item, error) {
	return Item{ID: id}, nil
}
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, T{})

	t.Run("typed path parameter binds as usual", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/items/42", nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
		}
		if want := `{"id":42}`; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("path parse failure is 400 before any JSON concerns", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/items/abc", nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
		}
		if !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), "bad-id") {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want the rendered error branch", rec.Body.String())
		}
	})
}
